  "history_url": "http://localhost:8100/usage/calls/01a1ea0c-366a-7422-92fd-d10483900f95",
  "sql": "WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customers_city_customers_regions_name AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.city" AS "customers__city",
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.regions.name" AS "customers__regions__name",
    _stage_inner."orders.amount_sum_partition_by_customers_city_customers_regions_name" AS "amount_sum_partition_by_customers_city_customers_regions_name"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customers.city AS "orders.customers.city",
      customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum_partition_by_customers_city_customers_regions_name"
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
      ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
    LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
      ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
    GROUP BY
      customers.city,
      customers__regions.name
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _cm_orders___avg_partition_by_customers_regions_name AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders.customers.regions.name" AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(AVG(_base._v) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.avg_city_revenue"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
      customers.city AS _ek0,
      customers__regions.name AS _ek1,
      MAX(
        _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customers_city_customers_regions_name."amount_sum_partition_by_customers_city_customers_regions_name"
      ) AS _v
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
      ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
    LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
      ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
    LEFT JOIN _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customers_city_customers_regions_name
      ON customers.city IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customers_city_customers_regions_name."customers__city"
      AND customers__regions.name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customers_city_customers_regions_name."customers__regions__name"
    GROUP BY
      customers__regions.name,
      customers.city,
      customers__regions.name
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base."orders.customers.regions.name"
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
  _cm_orders___avg_partition_by_customers_regions_name."orders.avg_city_revenue"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders___avg_partition_by_customers_regions_name
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders___avg_partition_by_customers_regions_name."orders.customers.regions.name"
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 101"
}

args.message: Average city revenue for each region. Each city's revenue is the sum of its order amounts; each city counts once in its region's average. Orders whose customer has no known region are in the null group.
